hooks.command: i=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$i" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("command",""))'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]|[[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create([[:space:]]|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[[:space:]])(--draft|-d)([[:space:]=]|$)'; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Open PRs as drafts: re-run this as gh pr create --draft ..., push freely, and run gh pr ready only when the work is done. Drafts run no CI and GitHub Actions minutes are a hard monthly budget."}}'; fi
